lede.zh: 本报告覆盖 GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 在 8×Ascend 950DT 上的 Agent 轨迹回放、热前缀长上下文检索与固定输出并发阶梯。
lede.en: This report covers Agent trace replay, hot-prefix long-context retrieval, and fixed-output concurrency for GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 on eight Ascend 950DT accelerators.

intro.zh: 所有结果只对应本页所列 GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 权重与 950DT 服务配置。Agent 回放、热前缀检索、固定输出解码阶梯分开呈现。
intro.en: All measurements apply only to the GLM-5.3-Flash W8A8-MXFP8 checkpoint and 950DT setup listed here. Agent replay, hot-prefix retrieval, and fixed-output decode sweeps are shown separately.

note.zh: 长上下文每档 8 个性能请求；P95 主要供本轮同口径对照。缓存命中率超过 99.8%，因此这些延迟代表高前缀复用场景，不代表冷启动预填充。
note.en: Each long-context point has eight performance requests; P95 is mainly for same-run comparison. Prefix hit rate exceeds 99.8%, so these latencies represent high prefix reuse, not cold prefill.

heading.zh: 多轮轨迹的完成率保持完整，并发提高输出吞吐
heading.en: Replay completion stays complete as concurrency increases aggregate output

intro.zh: 冻结的公开 coding 轨迹子集：16 个会话、437 轮；后续请求包含服务当轮生成的回答，工具结果按轨迹回放，不调用真实外部工具。C1 与 C8 使用独立 132K 服务配置臂。
intro.en: Frozen public coding-trace subset: 16 sessions and 437 turns. Later prompts include the service-generated replies; tool results are replayed from the trace without invoking live tools. C1 and C8 use a separate 132K serving configuration.

notes.zh: 两档均 437/437 请求完成，无取消。输出吞吐是整段回放窗口聚合值；它不代表 Agent 任务成功率或单请求 decode speed。
notes.en: All 437/437 requests completed in both runs with no cancellations. Output throughput is aggregated across the replay window; it is not Agent task success or per-request decode speed.

body.en: Trace entries include recorded tool outputs, but no external tools are called during the test. Performance must not be interpreted as tool-call accuracy or end-to-end task success.

heading.zh: 热前缀检索覆盖 256K 至 1M 输入，检索问题均命中答案键
heading.en: Hot-prefix retrieval spans 256K to 1M input, with all retrieval probes matching their answer keys

intro.zh: 语料来自 116 段不重复公开 RAG 文本，约 5.07M tokens；每档植入 8 个合成两跳问题。首个请求用于前缀填充，性能阶段复用前缀并更换问题后缀。
intro.en: Corpus contains 116 distinct public RAG passages, about 5.07M tokens, with eight synthetic two-hop questions per length. The initial request fills the prefix; performance requests reuse it with a changed question suffix.

notes.zh: 1M C1 与 C2 的检索探针均为 8/8；这是实验室构造的检索校验，不是官方 RULER 或 LongBench 分数。C2 的 3.39 秒填充值来自前缀已驻留后的 warm 请求，不是冷启动时间。
notes.en: Retrieval probes pass 8/8 at 1M for C1 and C2. This is a lab retrieval check, not an official RULER or LongBench score. The 3.39-second C2 fill is a warm request with the prefix already resident, not a cold-prefill time.

notes.zh: 每个性能点只有 8 个请求，P95 主要用于当前同口径运行观察。1M 长度属于实验性验证，超出该硬件/软件组合文档列出的 200K 支持长度，不构成官方保证。
notes.en: Each performance point has eight requests; P95 is mainly an observation for this consistent run. 1M is experimental validation beyond the 200K length listed in the hardware/software support documentation and is not an official guarantee.

heading.zh: 固定 128-token 输出下，高并发先推高首 token 和解码延迟
heading.en: With fixed 128-token output, higher concurrency raises both first-token and decode latency

intro.zh: 同一热前缀检索提示固定输出 128 tokens，并忽略 EOS，以测量解码压力；每档 8 个请求。升档门槛为 TTFT P95 或 TPOT P95 相对前档增加超过 50%。
intro.en: The same hot-prefix retrieval prompt generates exactly 128 output tokens with EOS ignored to measure decode pressure; eight requests per point. The step-up gate pauses when TTFT P95 or TPOT P95 rises more than 50% from the prior point.

notes.zh: 256K C4 相对 C2 的 TTFT P95 / TPOT P95 分别增加 218% / 177%，超过暂停线；C8 是用户指定的边界补测。512K C4 也已触发暂停，因此没有继续升档。
notes.en: At 256K C4, TTFT P95 / TPOT P95 rise 218% / 177% from C2, exceeding the pause threshold; C8 is an explicitly requested boundary probe. 512K C4 also reaches the pause condition, so no higher step was run.

title.en: 256K hot prefix: concurrency and TTFT P95

methodIntro.zh: 8×Ascend 950DT，TP8 + EP，MTP3；AIPerf 0.13.0。长上下文服务最大序列设置为 1,048,576 tokens。
methodIntro.en: Eight Ascend 950DT accelerators, TP8 + EP, MTP3; AIPerf 0.13.0. Maximum sequence length was set to 1,048,576 tokens for long-context serving.

methodNotes.zh: 自然答案平均约 11–13 tokens，不能稳定估计 TPOT；并发阶梯另用固定 128-token 输出，仅用于解码压力观察。
methodNotes.en: Natural answers average about 11–13 tokens and do not support stable TPOT estimates; the concurrency sweep uses fixed 128-token output for decode-stress observation only.

methodNotes.zh: 检索语料与问题为独立实验设计，检索命中率不等于官方基准成绩。没有公开机器地址、主机名、权重路径、日志路径或凭据。
methodNotes.en: Corpus and retrieval questions were designed for this experiment; retrieval checks are not official benchmark scores. Machine addresses, hostnames, checkpoint paths, log paths, and credentials are omitted.
